description: Main source file for Playwright test setup, including imports, fixture definitions, test configuration, and utility functions for managing test contexts, artifacts, and tracing.

classes.name: SnapshotRecorder
classes.description: Handles capturing and managing snapshots (screenshots) during tests, including temporary storage and conditional capturing based on test failure or retry.

classes.name: ArtifactsRecorder
classes.description: Manages artifacts such as screenshots and traces, coordinates with contexts and pages, and handles trace recording and error snapshotting.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Generates a descriptive title for API call steps, optionally including locator descriptions.

methods.name: tracing
methods.description: Returns the current test's tracing object for managing trace recording.

methods.name: connectOptionsFromEnv
methods.description: Reads environment variables to configure WebSocket connection options for remote browser connections.

methods.name: normalizeVideoMode
methods.description: Normalizes various representations of video mode settings into a standard VideoMode string.

methods.name: shouldCaptureVideo
methods.description: Determines whether to capture video based on the current video mode and test retry count.

methods.name: normalizeScreenshotMode
methods.description: Normalizes screenshot mode options into a standard string.

methods.name: attachConnectedHeaderIfNeeded
methods.description: Attaches headers from the browser connection to the test info as attachments if applicable.

methods.name: resolveFileToConfig
methods.description: Resolves a file path relative to the test configuration file.

methods.name: resolveClientCerticates
methods.description: Resolves paths for client certificate files based on the test config.
